title: Advertising
slide_intent: Teach how to order an outdoor message within a single display frame. A passerby needs to connect a short statement to a subject quickly.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can use its boxed typography and a partially revealed image as complementary ways into the same campaign message.
demonstration: One framed advertisement fills the view. A pink headline and larger black-and-cyan statement cross a cropped photographic treatment. A globe illustration, dots and an arrow add secondary accents.
practical_value: Choose a compact headline, verify its reading order against the photograph, and leave the signature a clear position in the corner.

content_islands.name: Display context
content_islands.spec: Show the whole framed panel within its physical setting, retaining the translucent navigation rail.

content_islands.name: Poster hierarchy
content_islands.spec: On cyan, group the pink and black message blocks around the image openings. Position the small brand signature at upper right and distribute secondary graphics around the message.
